list.title: CSS Solved Pair of Words
list.subtitle: CSS English pair distinctions with English and Urdu meanings

words.urdu:
Access: رسائی
Excess: حد سے زیادتی
words.meaning:
Access: the method or possibility of getting near to a place or person, or the right to use or look at something
Example: The only access to the village is by boat.

Excess: an amount which is more than acceptable, expected or reasonable
Example: An excess of enthusiasm is not always a good thing.
examples: The only access to the village is by boat.
An excess of enthusiasm is not always a good thing.

words.urdu:
Accident: حادثہ؛ غیر متوقع نقصان یا چوٹ
Incident: واقعہ؛ پیش آنے والا واقعہ
words.meaning:
Accident: something bad which happens that is not expected or intended, and which often damages something or injures someone
Example: Josh had an accident and spilled water all over his work.

Incident: something that happens; happening; occurrence
Example: We also investigate incidents which affect, or could affect, drinking water quality.
examples: Josh had an accident and spilled water all over his work.
We also investigate incidents which affect, or could affect, drinking water quality.

words.urdu:
Acculturate: ثقافتی طور پر ڈھلنا/تبدیل ہونا
Acclimatize: عادت ڈالنا/حالات کے مطابق ڈھلنا
words.meaning:
Acculturate: to undergo, or alter by acculturation
Example: Today the Iroquois are highly acculturated, holding jobs in communities surrounding the reservations.

Acclimatize: to (cause to) change to suit different conditions of life, weather, etc
Example: We found it impossible to acclimatize ourselves to the new working conditions.
examples: Today the Iroquois are highly acculturated, holding jobs in communities surrounding the reservations.
We found it impossible to acclimatize ourselves to the new working conditions.

words.urdu:
Adapt: مطابقت پیدا کرنا؛ موافق بنانا
Adopt: اپنانا؛ گود لینا
words.meaning:
Adapt: to change something to suit different conditions or uses
Example: Many software companies have adapted popular programs to the new operating system.

Adopt: to choose or take as your own
Example: Dr Kennedy has been adopted as the party's candidate for South Cambridge.
examples: Many software companies have adapted popular programs to the new operating system.
Dr Kennedy has been adopted as the party's candidate for South Cambridge.

words.urdu:
Addict: نشے کا عادی شخص
Edict: سرکاری حکم/فرمان
words.meaning:
Addict: وہ شخص جو کسی چیز خاص طور پر کسی مضر چیز کا عادی ہو
Example: There are a reported two million male cocaine addicts in the US.

Edict: خصوصاً طاقت یا ناانصافی کے ساتھ دیا گیا سرکاری حکم
Example: Most shops are ignoring the government's edict against Sunday trading.
examples: There are a reported two million male cocaine addicts in the US.
Most shops are ignoring the government's edict against Sunday trading.

words.urdu:
Adjoin: متصل ہونا؛ ساتھ واقع ہونا
Adjourn: اجلاس کو مؤخر کرنا؛ وقفہ دینا
words.meaning:
Adjoin: To be next to or adjoining something; to be connected or attached
Example: The garden adjoins the house, offering a beautiful view from the living room.

Adjourn: To suspend or break off a meeting, session, or legal proceeding with the intention of resuming later
Example: The meeting will adjourn for lunch and resume at 1:30 PM.
examples: The garden adjoins the house, offering a beautiful view from the living room.
The meeting will adjourn for lunch and resume at 1:30 PM.

words.urdu:
Adverse: منفی یا نقصان دہ
Averse: مخالف یا ناپسند
words.meaning:
Adverse: having a negative or harmful effect on something
Example: The match has been canceled due to adverse weather conditions.

Averse: strongly disliking or opposed to
Example: Few MPs are averse to the attention of the media.
examples: The match has been canceled due to adverse weather conditions.
Few MPs are averse to the attention of the media.

words.urdu:
Affection: محبت؛ کسی کے لیے محبت یا لگاؤ
Affectation: نقلی رَوَیّہ؛ دکھاوے کے لیے کی گئی حرکت
words.meaning:
Affection: a feeling of liking for a person or place
Example: He had a deep affection for his aunt.

Affectation: behavior or speech that is not sincere
Example: She has so many little affectations.
examples: He had a deep affection for his aunt.
She has so many little affectations.

words.urdu:
Affluence: دولت یا خدمات میں فراوانی
Effluence: نکاسی/جاری شئے
words.meaning:
Affluence: having a lot of money or owning a lot of things
Example: What we are seeing increasingly is a society of private affluence and public squalor.

Effluence: a thing that flows out or forth
Example: How can Reef Entertainment justify releasing this effluence on the general public?
examples: What we are seeing increasingly is a society of private affluence and public squalor.
How can Reef Entertainment justify releasing this effluence on the general public?

words.urdu:
Affluent: دولت مند
Effluent: نکاسی آب/فاضل سیال
words.meaning:
Affluent: Wealthy.
Example: The affluent family donated generously to charity.

Effluent: Liquid waste discharged into a river or the sea.
Example: The factory released effluent into the water.
examples: The affluent family donated generously to charity.
The factory released effluent into the water.

words.urdu:
All: تمام؛ سب
Awl: چھید کرنے والا چھوٹا نوکیلا آلہ (اوَل)
words.meaning:
All: every one (of), or the complete amount or number (of), or the whole (of)
Example: All animals have to eat in order to live.

Awl: a small, pointed tool for making holes in wood, leather, etc.
Example: That awl causes loud noise.
examples: All animals have to eat in order to live.
That awl causes loud noise.

words.urdu:
Allay: دُور کرنا؛ تسکین دینا
Ally: ساتھی؛ حلیف
words.meaning:
Allay: To diminish or put to rest (fear, suspicion, or worry)
Example: The doctor tried to allay the patient's concerns about the surgery.

Ally: A person, group, or nation that is united with another for a common purpose, often in a political or military context
Example: During World War II, the United States was an ally of the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union.
examples: The doctor tried to allay the patient's concerns about the surgery.
During World War II, the United States was an ally of the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union.

words.urdu:
Allude: اشارہ کرنا؛ بالواسطہ ذکر کرنا
Elude: چالاکی سے بچ جانا؛ فرار ہونا
words.meaning:
Allude: To make an indirect or passing reference to something
Example: In his speech, he alluded to the challenges the company faced last year.

Elude: To escape or avoid, often in a tricky or skillful way
Example: The criminal managed to elude capture for several weeks.
examples: In his speech, he alluded to the challenges the company faced last year.
The criminal managed to elude capture for several weeks.

words.urdu:
Allusive: اشاراتی؛ اشارات سے بھرپور
Elusive: حاصل کرنا یا بیان کرنا مشکل
words.meaning:
Allusive: containing a lot of allusions
Example: Her music is allusive.

Elusive: difficult to describe, find, achieve or remember
Example: The answers to these questions remain as elusive as ever.
examples: Her music is allusive.
The answers to these questions remain as elusive as ever.

words.urdu:
Altar: مذبح، مذہبی میز
Alter: تبدیل کرنا
words.meaning:
Altar: a type of table used in ceremonies in a Christian church or in other religious buildings
Example: A 3rd century Roman pagan altar was also recently found on the site.

Alter: to change something
Example: We've had to alter some of our plans.
examples: A 3rd century Roman pagan altar was also recently found on the site.
We've had to alter some of our plans.

words.urdu:
Alteration: تبدیلی
Altercation: شدید جھگڑا/تلخ نوبت تک پہنچنے والا تنازع
words.meaning:
Alteration: The act of making something different.
Example: The tailor made some alterations to my dress.

Altercation: A noisy argument.
Example: The two neighbours had an altercation over the fence.
examples: The tailor made some alterations to my dress.
The two neighbours had an altercation over the fence.

words.urdu:
Altogether: بالکل؛ مکمل طور پر
All together: ایک ساتھ؛ سب ایک وقت میں
words.meaning:
Altogether: completely or in total
Example: The government ought to abolish the tax altogether.

All together: all at the same time
Example: The last time we were all together was in the past.
examples: The government ought to abolish the tax altogether.
The last time we were all together was in the past.

words.urdu:
Amateur: شوقیہ
Professional: پیشہ ور/ماہِر
words.meaning:
Amateur: A person who engages in an activity for pleasure, not professionally.
Example: She is an amateur painter.

Professional: A person engaged in a specific occupation as a paid job.
Example: He is a professional lawyer.
examples: She is an amateur painter.
He is a professional lawyer.

words.urdu:
Ambiguous: غیر واضح؛ متعدد معانی رکھنے والا
Ambivalent: دو متضاد جذبات رکھنے والا؛ مخمصے میں مبتلا
words.meaning:
Ambiguous: having or expressing more than one possible meaning, sometimes intentionally
Example: His reply to my question was somewhat ambiguous.

Ambivalent: having two opposing feelings at the same time, or being uncertain about how you feel
Example: I felt very ambivalent about leaving home.
examples: His reply to my question was somewhat ambiguous.
I felt very ambivalent about leaving home.

words.urdu:
Amiable: مہربان، خوش مزاج
Amicable: دوستانہ، مہذب
words.meaning:
Amiable: describes a person or their behavior that is pleasant and friendly
Example: So amiable was the mood of the meeting that a decision was soon reached.

Amicable: relating to behavior between people that is pleasant often despite a difficult situation
Example: His manner was perfectly amicable but I felt uncomfortable.
examples: So amiable was the mood of the meeting that a decision was soon reached.
His manner was perfectly amicable but I felt uncomfortable.

words.urdu:
Amoral: بے اخلاق/اخلاقی اصولوں سے عاری
Immoral: غیر اخلاقی
words.meaning:
Amoral: without moral principles
Example: The spies are younger, less jaded but equally cynical and still operating in a wholly amoral world.

Immoral: morally wrong
Example: It's an immoral tax, because the poor will pay relatively more.
examples: The spies are younger, less jaded but equally cynical and still operating in a wholly amoral world.
It's an immoral tax, because the poor will pay relatively more.

words.urdu:
Annalist: سالنامہ نویس (تاریخی واقعات لکھنے والا)
Analyst: تجزیہ کار
words.meaning:
Annalist: A person who records or writes about historical events.
Example: The annalist carefully documented the events of the ancient empire in his detailed journals.

Analyst: A person who examines and interprets data, trends, or situations.
Example: The analyst reviewed the company's financial records to forecast future performance.
examples: The annalist carefully documented the events of the ancient empire in his detailed journals.
The analyst reviewed the company's financial records to forecast future performance.

words.urdu:
Antic: شرارتی/مضحکہ خیز حرکت
Antique: قدیم نوادرات
words.meaning:
Antic: A playful or humorous act or gesture.
Example: The jester's antic movements made the audience laugh.

Antique: An object or piece of art that is old and has value due to its age.
Example: The antique vase was over 100 years old and worth a lot of money.
examples: The jester's antic movements made the audience laugh.
The antique vase was over 100 years old and worth a lot of money.

words.urdu:
Apposite: مناسب؛ موزوں
Opposite: مخالف؛ بالکل مختلف
words.meaning:
Apposite: suitable and right for the occasion
Example: It is, however, apposite to note that this process will continue in the year ahead.

Opposite: completely different
Example: You'd never know they're sisters - they're completely opposite to each other in every way.
examples: It is, however, apposite to note that this process will continue in the year ahead.
You'd never know they're sisters - they're completely opposite to each other in every way.

words.urdu:
Appraise: جائزہ لینا؛ قدر یا کارکردگی کا اندازہ کرنا
Apprise: آگاہ کرنا
words.meaning:
Appraise: to examine someone or something in order to judge their qualities, success or needs
Example: At the end of each teaching practice, trainee teachers are asked to appraise their own performance.

Apprise: to tell someone about something
Example: The President has been apprised of the situation.
examples: At the end of each teaching practice, trainee teachers are asked to appraise their own performance.
The President has been apprised of the situation.

words.urdu:
Ardor: شدید جوش یا محبت
Order: ترتیب/نظم
words.meaning:
Ardor: زبردست جوش یا محبت
Example: Similarly, the Japanese seem to have less ardor for luxury goods than in the boom years of the late 90s.

Order: لوگوں یا چیزوں کا ترتیب سے بندوبست ہونا
Example: The children lined up in order of age/height.
examples: Similarly, the Japanese seem to have less ardor for luxury goods than in the boom years of the late 90s.
The children lined up in order of age/height.

words.urdu:
Artist: فنکار؛ مصوِّر/مجسمہ ساز
Artiste: ہنرمند پرفارمر؛ فنکار (اداکار/گلوکار/رقصاں)
words.meaning:
Artist: someone who paints, draws or makes sculptures
Example: Monet is one of my favorite artists.

Artiste: a skilled performer, especially a dancer, singer or actor
Example: Denise has been a solo artiste for over 20 years working all over the world.
examples: Monet is one of my favorite artists.
Denise has been a solo artiste for over 20 years working all over the world.

words.urdu:
Ascent: اوپر چڑھائی
Accent: لہجہ
words.meaning:
Ascent: when someone or something climbs or moves upwards
Example: As the plane made its ascent, we saw thick smoke coming from one engine.

Accent: the way in which people in a particular area, country or social group pronounce words
Example: He's got a strong Scottish accent.
examples: As the plane made its ascent, we saw thick smoke coming from one engine.
He's got a strong Scottish accent.

words.urdu:
Ascent: چڑھائی؛ اوپر جانا یا چڑھنا
Assent: منظوری؛ اجازت یا رضامندی
words.meaning:
Ascent: when someone or something climbs or moves upwards
Example: As the plane made its ascent, we saw thick smoke coming from one engine.

Assent: official agreement to or approval of an idea, plan or request
Example: Once the directors have given their assent to the proposal we can begin.
examples: As the plane made its ascent, we saw thick smoke coming from one engine.
Once the directors have given their assent to the proposal we can begin.

words.urdu:
Aspire: خواہش مند ہونا؛ بلند آرزو رکھنا
Expire: میعاد ختم ہونا؛ اختتام پذیر ہونا
words.meaning:
Aspire: to have a strong want or hope to do or have something
Example: Few people who aspire to fame ever achieve it.

Expire: If something which lasts for a fixed length of time expires, it comes to an end or stops being in use
Example: Our television license expires next month.
examples: Few people who aspire to fame ever achieve it.
Our television license expires next month.

words.urdu:
Assay: تجزیاتی آزمائش، جانچ
Essay: مضمون
words.meaning:
Assay: An examination or testing, especially of materials like metals or drugs
Example: A positive result has been obtained in a mouse lymphoma assay.

Essay: A short piece of writing on a particular subject
Example: The Diploma is assessed by three essays of 3,000 words each.
examples: A positive result has been obtained in a mouse lymphoma assay.
The Diploma is assessed by three essays of 3,000 words each.

words.urdu:
Atheist: خدا کے وجود کا انکار کرنے والا
Agnostic: خدا کے وجود کے بارے میں غیر یقینی یا نا معلوم سمجھنے والا
words.meaning:
Atheist: someone who believes that God or gods do not exist
Example: I know an atheist who says ' Oh god!'

Agnostic: someone who does not know, or believes that it is impossible to know, whether a god exists
Example: Although he was raised a Catholic, he was an agnostic for most of his adult life.
examples: I know an atheist who says ' Oh god!'
Although he was raised a Catholic, he was an agnostic for most of his adult life.

words.urdu:
Auger: مٹی یا لکڑی میں سوراخ کرنے والا آلہ
Augur: بشارت دینا؛ کسی بات کی علامت ہونا
words.meaning:
Auger: A tool consisting of a twisted rod of metal fixed to a handle, used for making large holes in wood or the ground.
Example: To plant the tree, use an auger to make a hole in the soil.

Augur: To be a sign of something, especially something good or bad in the future.
Example: The dark clouds augur a storm coming soon.
examples: To plant the tree, use an auger to make a hole in the soil.
The dark clouds augur a storm coming soon.

words.urdu:
Avenge: بدلہ لینا؛ سزا دینا
Revenge: انتقام؛ بدلہ
words.meaning:
Avenge: to do harm to or punish the person responsible for something bad done to you
Example: He swore he would avenge his brother's death.

Revenge: harm done to someone as a punishment for harm that they have done to someone else
Example: He is believed to have been shot by a rival gang in revenge for the shootings last week.
examples: He swore he would avenge his brother's death.
He is believed to have been shot by a rival gang in revenge for the shootings last week.

words.urdu:
Aviary: پرندوں کا پنجرہ
Apiary: مکھیوں کو پالنے کی جگہ/شہد کی چھتیاں
words.meaning:
Aviary: A large cage or closed space in which birds are kept as pets.
Example: I have an aviary with 17 birds.

Apiary: A place where people keep bees, especially a collection of hives kept to provide honey.
Example: I once visited an apiary where there were numerous cardboard boxes scattered around.
examples: I have an aviary with 17 birds.
I once visited an apiary where there were numerous cardboard boxes scattered around.

words.urdu:
Bad: برا؛ ناگوار
Badly: شدید انداز میں؛ نقصان دہ طریقے سے
words.meaning:
Bad: unpleasant; causing difficulties or harm
Example: Our holiday was spoiled by bad weather.

Badly: in a severe and harmful way
Example: She was badly affected by the events in her childhood.
examples: Our holiday was spoiled by bad weather.
She was badly affected by the events in her childhood.

words.urdu:
Ballot: خفیہ رائے دہی
Ballet: بیلے (رقص)
words.meaning:
Ballot: a system or occasion of secret voting
Example: They decided to hold a ballot.

Ballet: a type of dancing where carefully organized movements tell a story or express an idea
Example: By the age of fifteen he had already composed his first ballet.
examples: They decided to hold a ballot.
By the age of fifteen he had already composed his first ballet.

words.urdu:
Banned: ممنوع
Band: گروپ/بینڈ
words.meaning:
Banned: Something that is prohibited.
Example: The death penalty is banned in New York and New Jersey.

Band: A group of people working together, particularly in the field of music.
Example: 9 zero Band's new album, I remember being instantly impressed.
examples: The death penalty is banned in New York and New Jersey.
9 zero Band's new album, I remember being instantly impressed.

words.urdu:
Barbarism: ظلم و ستم؛ بربریت
Barbarity: بربریت؛ بے رحمی
words.meaning:
Barbarism: extremely cruel and unpleasant behavior
Example: He witnessed some appalling acts of barbarism during the war.

Barbarity: behavior that is very cruel, or a very cruel act
Example: This barbarity must cease!
examples: He witnessed some appalling acts of barbarism during the war.
This barbarity must cease!

words.urdu:
Barmy: پاگلانہ/بےوقوفانہ
Balmy: خشگوار/ملائم (موسم)
words.meaning:
Barmy: Crazy, foolish, or mentally unstable.
Example: It was a barmy idea to leave the house during the storm.

Balmy: Mild and pleasant, especially referring to the weather.
Example: We enjoyed a balmy evening on the beach, with a gentle breeze and warm temperatures.
examples: It was a barmy idea to leave the house during the storm.
We enjoyed a balmy evening on the beach, with a gentle breeze and warm temperatures.

words.urdu:
Barred: باروں سے گھرا ہوا
Bard: شاعر/قصہ گو
words.meaning:
Barred: Provided with one or more bars; closed off by bars.
Example: Barred owls roosting by the side of the road!

Bard: An ancient poet who composes and sings poems about heroes and epic events.
Example: Bards of the time could recite, or chant, long epic poems.
examples: Barred owls roosting by the side of the road!
Bards of the time could recite, or chant, long epic poems.

words.urdu:
Bases: بنیادیں؛ اساسیں
Basis: بنیاد؛ اساس
words.meaning:
Bases: The plural of 'base,' referring to the fundamental parts or starting points of something
Example: The bases of the building's structure were reinforced to withstand earthquakes.

Basis: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or action
Example: Her decision to leave was based on the strong basis of wanting a better future.
examples: The bases of the building's structure were reinforced to withstand earthquakes.
Her decision to leave was based on the strong basis of wanting a better future.

words.urdu:
Bear: برداشت کرنا، قبول کرنا
Bare: ننگا، بے پردہ
words.meaning:
Bear: to accept, tolerate or endure especially something unpleasant
Example: It's your decision - you must bear the responsibility if things go wrong.

Bare: without any clothes or not covered by anything
Example: Don't walk around outside in your bare feet.
examples: It's your decision - you must bear the responsibility if things go wrong.
Don't walk around outside in your bare feet.

words.urdu:
Below: نیچے، ذیل میں
Beneath: نیچے، نیچے کی جانب
words.meaning:
Below: in a lower position
Example: From the top of the skyscraper the cars below us looked like insects.

Beneath: in or to a lower position
Example: Jeremy hid the letter beneath a pile of papers.
examples: From the top of the skyscraper the cars below us looked like insects.
Jeremy hid the letter beneath a pile of papers.

words.urdu:
Beneficent: نیک عمل کرنے والا؛ خیرخواہ
Beneficial: فائدہ مند؛ مفید
words.meaning:
Beneficent: Performing or causing good or charitable actions
Example: The beneficent charity helped thousands of people in need during the holiday season.

Beneficial: Having a positive effect or helping to improve something
Example: Regular exercise is beneficial for both physical and mental health.
examples: The beneficent charity helped thousands of people in need during the holiday season.
Regular exercise is beneficial for both physical and mental health.

words.urdu:
Berth: ٹرین/کشتی میں بستر؛ جہاز کے ٹھہرنے کی جگہ
Birth: پیدائش
words.meaning:
Berth: a bed in a boat, train, etc., or a place for a ship or boat to stay in a port
Example: She booked a berth on the train from London to Aberdeen.

Birth: Child’s birth
Example: He weighed eight pounds at birth.
examples: She booked a berth on the train from London to Aberdeen.
He weighed eight pounds at birth.

words.urdu:
Beside: کے پہلو میں؛ ساتھ
Besides: اس کے علاوہ؛ مزید
words.meaning:
Beside: at the side of, next to
Example: Come and sit here beside me.

Besides: in addition to; also
Example: Do you play any other sports besides football and basketball?
examples: Come and sit here beside me.
Do you play any other sports besides football and basketball?

words.urdu:
Bolster: حمایت کرنا/تقویت دینا
Prop: سہارنا/تکیہ/سہارا دینا
words.meaning:
Bolster: To support or strengthen.
Example: His speech bolstered my confidence.

Prop: To support by placing something beneath or against.
Example: He propped the ladder against the wall.
examples: His speech bolstered my confidence.
He propped the ladder against the wall.

words.urdu:
Bony: ہڈی نما/دبلا یا کم گوشت
Bonny: خوبصورت/پیاری
words.meaning:
Bony: Consisting of or resembling bone; lean or gaunt.
Example: She suddenly held up a small, bony finger and pointed across the room.

Bonny: Attractive, beautiful, or fair (especially used in Scottish or Northern English).
Example: Bonny, bouncing baby Freddie was her heart's desire and joy.
examples: She suddenly held up a small, bony finger and pointed across the room.
Bonny, bouncing baby Freddie was her heart's desire and joy.

words.urdu:
Born: پیدا ہوا
Borne: لے جایا گیا/منتقَل یا برداشت کیا گیا
words.meaning:
Born: Existing as a result of birth.
Example: Ali was born in Lahore.

Borne: Carried or transported by the thing specified; carried or endured.
Example: Dengue, malaria and chikungunya are vector-borne diseases.
examples: Ali was born in Lahore.
Dengue, malaria and chikungunya are vector-borne diseases.

words.urdu:
Boy: لڑکا
Buoy: سمندری نشان؛ تیرتا نشان (بوئی)
words.meaning:
Boy: a male child

words.urdu:

Depreciate: قدر کم ہونا یا کم کرنا؛ قیمت میں کمی

words.urdu:

Dissolute: بے لگام؛ لذت پرست یا بداخلاق

words.urdu:

words.urdu:

Defer: موخر کرنا؛ بعد میں ملتوی کرنا

Example: The twins look alike, but they differ in temperament.

examples: The twins look alike, but they differ in temperament.
My bank has agreed to defer the repayments on my loan while I'm still a student.

Differ with: کسی بات سے اختلاف کرنا
words.meaning:

Example: His views differ considerably from those of his parents.

Differ with: to disagree
Example: I beg to differ with you on that point.
examples: His views differ considerably from those of his parents.
I beg to differ with you on that point.

words.urdu:

Dingy: مدھم/گھسا پھٹا/گندا
words.meaning:

Dingy: Shabby, dark, or dirty in appearance.

words.urdu:

Exposure: بے نقاب ہونا/افشاء

examples: Any public disclosure of this information would be very damaging to the company.
The exposure of the minister's love affair forced him to resign.

words.urdu:

Discreet: محتاط، رازدار
words.meaning:

Discreet: Careful and prudent in one’s speech or actions, especially in order to keep something confidential.

examples: These are discrete projects, and their funding records should be kept separate.
Discreet silence over the matter.

words.urdu:

Decease: وفات، موت

Decease: a person's death

examples: Starvation and diseases have killed thousands of refugees.
The house will not be yours till after your mother's decease.

words.urdu:
Dissonance: عدمِ ہم آہنگی
Harmony: ہم آہنگی

Dissonance: Lack of harmony.

Harmony: Agreement or pleasing arrangement of parts.

words.urdu:

Distinctive: نمایاں خصوصیت رکھنے والا؛ منفرد

Example: She's got a very distinctive voice.

She's got a very distinctive voice.

words.urdu:

Detract: To reduce or take away from the value or quality of something

His rude comments did nothing but detract from the overall success of the event.

words.urdu:

Doze: قلیل نیند؛ غنودگی

Doze: A short, light sleep.

examples: The doctor prescribed a dose of antibiotics to be taken twice daily.
After lunch, he took a quick doze before returning to work.

words.urdu:

Drought: خشک سالی

Drought: A prolonged period of dry weather causing water shortage.

examples: I felt a cool draught coming from the open window.
The farmers were worried about the drought that had been affecting their crops for months.

words.urdu:

Duel: دو افراد کے درمیان مقابلہ/دوئل

The composer Strauss was once challenged to a duel.

words.urdu:

Dew: شبنم

Dew: drops of water that form on the ground and other surfaces outside during the night

examples: The next meeting is due to be held in three months' time.
There was moderate dew on the grass.

words.urdu:

Illicit: غیر قانونی؛ ممنوع

Illicit: Illegal or forbidden by law or morality.

examples: The question elicited laughter.
Illicit trade harms the economy.

words.urdu:

Illegible: ناقابلِ مطالعہ/ناواضح تحریر

Example: Only people over 18 are eligible to vote.

Illegible: بہت غیر ترتیب شدہ یا واضح نہ ہونے کی وجہ سے پڑھنے کے قابل نہ ہونا
Example: His writing is almost illegible.
examples: Only people over 18 are eligible to vote.
His writing is almost illegible.

words.urdu:

Immigrate: کسی ملک میں ہجرت کر کے آنا
words.meaning:

Immigrate: To come to live in a different country.

examples: Many people emigrated from Europe to America during the 19th century.
After the war, they immigrated to Canada to start a new life.

words.urdu:

Imminent: قریب الوقوع/جلد وقوع پزیر

Imminent: بہت جلد پیش آنے والا، قریب الوقوع

words.urdu:

Prominent: نمایاں، اہم

Prominent: very well-known and important
Example: The government should be playing a more prominent role in promoting human rights.

words.urdu:

words.urdu:

Envious: حسد مند؛ دوسروں کی چیزوں کا خواہش مند
words.meaning:

Envious: wishing you had what another person has

examples: She's in the enviable position of being able to choose who she works for.
I'm very envious of your new coat - it's lovely.

words.urdu:

Jealousy: شک و حسد؛ کسی کے مقام یا تعلق کے بارے میں غیر مطمئن ہونا
words.meaning:

Example: I envy her ability to speak three languages fluently.

Jealousy: A feeling of unhappiness because someone else has something you want.

His jealousy of his colleague's promotion caused tension in the office.

words.urdu:

Epoch: A period of time considered in terms of noteworthy and characteristic events or developments.

examples: Epic tale that favors the bizarre.
Epoch of the final decline of democracy.

examples: Oscar Wilde was known for his sharp epigrams that often conveyed profound truths with humor.

words.urdu:

Superfluous: more than is needed or wanted
Example: The report was marred by a mass of superfluous detail.
examples: He's fun to be with, but he's very superficial.
The report was marred by a mass of superfluous detail.

words.urdu:

Taught: سکھایا (ماضی)
words.meaning:

Taught: Past tense of teach.
Example: She taught English for years.
examples: The rope was pulled taut.
She taught English for years.

words.urdu:
Temporal: دنیاوی؛ مادی
Temporary: عارضی
words.meaning:
Temporal: relating to practical matters or physical things, rather than spiritual ones
Example: Her starting point: 'The future is the only temporal area over which people have power.'

Temporary: not lasting or needed for very long

examples: Her starting point: 'The future is the only temporal area over which people have power.'
The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.

words.urdu:

Torturous: عذاب دینے والا؛ تکلیف دہ

Example: He took a tortuous route through back streets to avoid the traffic.

Torturous: Causing physical or emotional pain, resembling torture
Example: It was torturous to think that he could have stopped the boy from running into the road.
examples: He took a tortuous route through back streets to avoid the traffic.
It was torturous to think that he could have stopped the boy from running into the road.

words.urdu:
Trifling: چھوٹا یا غیر اہم
Trivial: معمولی؛ کم اہم
words.meaning:
Trifling: Small, insignificant, or not important.

Trivial: Having little value or importance.
Example: He spent hours worrying about trivial matters instead of focusing on the bigger picture.
examples: The issue they were arguing about was so trifling that it didn't matter in the long run.
He spent hours worrying about trivial matters instead of focusing on the bigger picture.

words.urdu:
Urban: شہری
Urbane: مؤدب اور نفیس
words.meaning:

Urbane: confident, comfortable and polite in social situations
Example: He was always well informed and brought an urbane authority to everything he did.
examples: The development is clearly urban in character, but lacks local shops and facilities.
He was always well informed and brought an urbane authority to everything he did.

words.urdu:

Uxorious: بیوی کے بارے میں حد سے زیادہ محبت کرنے والا
words.meaning:

Example: The case involved uxoricide.

Uxorious: Excessively devoted or submissive to one’s wife.

examples: The case involved uxoricide.
He was mocked for being uxorious.

words.urdu:
Valet: نِگہبان/نوُکرِ شخصی (لباس اور ذاتی ضروریات کا خیال رکھنے والا)
Varlet: نوکر/چھوٹا سرورکار؛ چالاک یا شرارتی آدمی (تاریخی معنی)
words.meaning:
Valet: A personal servant, especially one who attends to the clothing and personal needs of someone
Example: The valet helped the gentleman put on his suit before the important event.

Varlet: A young attendant or servant, often used historically for someone of low rank; also can mean a rogue or scoundrel
Example: The knight scolded the varlet for his mischievous behavior.
examples: The valet helped the gentleman put on his suit before the important event.
The knight scolded the varlet for his mischievous behavior.

words.urdu:

Vellum: بچھڑے کی کھال سے بنا نفیس پارچمنٹ
words.meaning:
Vallum: A rampart or defensive wall, especially in Roman fortifications.
Example: Hadrian’s Wall included a vallum.

Vellum: Fine parchment made from calfskin, used for manuscripts.
Example: Medieval texts were written on vellum.
examples: Hadrian’s Wall included a vallum.
Medieval texts were written on vellum.

words.urdu:
Veil: پردہ؛ نقاب
Vale: وادی (ناموں میں استعمال)
words.meaning:

Example: The women wore black veils which covered all but their eyes.

Vale: used in the name of some valleys

examples: The women wore black veils which covered all but their eyes.
The Vale of Evesham

words.urdu:

Venial: معاف کردہ؛ معمولی جرم یا غلطی
words.meaning:
Venal: Corrupt or willing to act dishonestly for personal gain, especially money.
Example: The venal politician accepted bribes in exchange for passing laws that favored the companies.

Venial: A minor or easily forgivable sin or offense.
Example: Missing a meeting is a venial offense, easily overlooked.
examples: The venal politician accepted bribes in exchange for passing laws that favored the companies.
Missing a meeting is a venial offense, easily overlooked.

words.urdu:

Deceit: دھوکہ/فریب
words.meaning:

Deceit: Dishonesty.
Example: The plan was full of deceit.
examples: The journalist is known for her veracity.
The plan was full of deceit.

words.urdu:
Veracity: سچائی؛ درستگی
Voracity: شدید بھوک یا بہت زیادہ کھانے کی خواہش
words.meaning:
Veracity: Conformity to facts; accuracy, truthfulness
Example: Officials expressed doubts concerning the veracity of the story.

Voracity: The quality of being eager to consume large quantities of food; an insatiable appetite or desire
Example: There is a higher thirst and voracity for a variety of pertinent content.
examples: Officials expressed doubts concerning the veracity of the story.
There is a higher thirst and voracity for a variety of pertinent content.

words.urdu:
Verbal: زبانی
Verbose: طویل بیان کرنے والا؛ غیر ضروری الفاظ استعمال کرنے والا
words.meaning:
Verbal: spoken rather than written
Example: Airport officials received a stream of verbal abuse from angry passengers whose flights had been delayed.

Verbose: using or containing more words than are necessary
Example: He was a notoriously verbose after-dinner speaker.
examples: Airport officials received a stream of verbal abuse from angry passengers whose flights had been delayed.
He was a notoriously verbose after-dinner speaker.

words.urdu:

Virtual: مجازی (کمپیوٹر پر مبنی)
words.meaning:

Example: He described them as a virtuous and hard-working people.

Virtual: describes something that can be done or seen using a computer and therefore without going anywhere or talking to anyone
Example: In tests, we have found the virtual machine runs at a reasonable speed.
examples: He described them as a virtuous and hard-working people.
In tests, we have found the virtual machine runs at a reasonable speed.

words.urdu:
Voracity: زیادہ کھانے کی خواہش
Veracity: سچائی/درستگی
words.meaning:
Voracity: بیش از حد کھانے کی خواہش یا لا لچاری
Example: On reaching the ship they were offered some bread, which they devoured with a voracious appetite.

Veracity: سچائی یا درستگی کی خصوصیت
Example: The veracity of the second claim can be tested against the findings of archeology.
examples: On reaching the ship they were offered some bread, which they devoured with a voracious appetite.
The veracity of the second claim can be tested against the findings of archeology.

words.urdu:

Wave: ہاتھ ہلانا (اظہارِ سلام)

Wave: Move hand in greeting.

examples: She decided to waive her right to a lawyer.
The child waved at his friend.

words.urdu:

Waver: ہچکچانا/غیر یقینی ہونا

words.urdu:

words.meaning:

Waive: to give up or forgo (a right, claim, privilege, etc.)

examples: I waved to him from the window but he didn't see me.
The bank manager waived the charge as we were old and valued customers.

words.urdu:
Weather: موسم/فضائی حالات

Example: The weather in the hills can change very quickly, so take suitable clothing.

Whether: اگر، یا نہیں — کسی بات کے امکان یا انتخاب کا اظہار
Example: I wasn't sure whether you'd like it.

I wasn't sure whether you'd like it.

words.urdu:

Example: My bike got wet in the rain.

Whet: To sharpen or to stimulate someone’s interest or desire

examples: My bike got wet in the rain.
I've read an excerpt of the book on the web and it whetted my appetite.

words.urdu:
Wile: چالاکی/فریب

While: A period of time; also used in expressions like 'meanwhile' or 'a while.'

He decided to rest for a while before continuing his journey.

Willful: ارادی، جان بوجھ کر کیا گیا

The place reeked of smoke.
